entry.title: Awesome Python Updates on Oct 05 - Oct 11, 2026
entry.content:
Projects / AI and Agents

  • Vendor Agent SDKs
    • claude-agent-sdk (⭐8.2k) - Anthropic's Python SDK for building AI agents on Claude Code's harness — custom tools, in-process MCP servers, hooks.
    • openai-agents (⭐30k) - OpenAI's framework for building and managing AI agents.
    • google-adk (⭐22k) - Google's code-first toolkit for building, evaluating, and deploying AI agents.
  • Model Context Protocol
    • mcp (⭐24k) - The official Python SDK for building Model Context Protocol servers and clients.
    • fastmcp (⭐28k) - A high-level, Pythonic framework for building MCP servers and clients.
  • Personal Assistants
    • hermes-agent (⭐251k) - An adaptive personal AI assistant that grows with you.
    • AstrBot (⭐41k) - A multi-platform AI assistant that connects LLMs to chat apps like Telegram, Slack, and QQ, extensible with Python plugins.
  • LLM Gateways
    • litellm (⭐60k) - Call 100+ LLMs using OpenAI format.
  • Speech
    • faster-whisper (⭐26k) - A Whisper reimplementation on CTranslate2, up to 4 times faster than openai-whisper with less memory.
    • openai-whisper (⭐110k) - A general-purpose automatic speech recognition model trained on 680k hours of multilingual and multitask supervised data.
    • gTTS (⭐2.6k) - Python library and CLI tool for converting text to speech using Google Translate TTS.
    • funasr (⭐21k) - Industrial-grade speech recognition toolkit with speaker diarization and emotion detection.

Projects / Machine Learning

  • Time Series Forecasting
    • prophet (⭐20k) - A tool for producing forecasts for time series with multiple seasonality and trend changes.
    • statsforecast (⭐4.9k) - Fast statistical forecasting models such as ARIMA, ETS, and Theta, compiled with numba.
    • sktime (⭐10k) - A unified scikit-learn-style framework for forecasting and other time-series learning tasks.
    • timesfm (⭐34k) - A pretrained foundation model from Google Research for time-series forecasting, with non-commercial default weights.

Projects / Web APIs

  • Flask
    • flask-restx (⭐2.2k) - Fully featured framework for fast, easy and documented API development with Flask.
    • flask-smorest (⭐717) - A Flask/Marshmallow-based REST API framework with automatic OpenAPI documentation.
    • apiflask (⭐1.1k) - A lightweight Python web API framework based on Flask, supporting marshmallow schemas and Pydantic models.

Projects / Web Asset Management

  • whitenoise (⭐2.8k) - Radically simplified static file serving for WSGI applications, with compression and caching headers.

Projects / Admin Panels

  • sqladmin (⭐2.8k) - An admin interface for SQLAlchemy models in FastAPI and Starlette.

Projects / Web Scraping

  • Content Extraction
    • markdownify (⭐2.3k) - Convert HTML to Markdown, with customizable tag handling.
    • feedparser (⭐2.4k) - Universal feed parser.
    • trafilatura (⭐6.9k) - A tool for gathering text and metadata from the web, with built-in content filtering.

Projects / Email

  • aiosmtplib (⭐432) - An asyncio SMTP client.
  • django-anymail (⭐1.9k) - Django email backends and webhooks for transactional email services such as Amazon SES, Brevo, Mailgun, Postmark, and Resend.

Projects / Database

  • Vector
    • lancedb (⭐12k) - A developer-friendly embedded retrieval database for multimodal AI.
    • chromadb (⭐29k) - An open-source embedding database for building AI applications with embeddings and semantic search.
    • zvec (⭐16k) - A lightweight, in-process vector database that embeds directly into applications.

Projects / Data Validation

  • great-expectations (⭐12k) - A data quality framework for validating, documenting, and profiling data with declarative expectations.

Projects / Data Visualization

  • Specialized
    • graphviz (⭐1.8k) - Simple Python interface for creating and rendering Graphviz graphs.
    • cartopy (⭐1.6k) - A cartographic python library with matplotlib support.
    • graphify (⭐125k) - Turn any folder of code, SQL schemas, docs, papers, images, or videos into a queryable knowledge graph.

Projects / Science

  • Biology and Chemistry
    • rdkit (⭐3.6k) - Cheminformatics and Machine Learning Software.
    • biopython (⭐5.2k) - Biopython is a set of freely available tools for biological computation.

Projects / Algorithms and Design Patterns

  • Design Patterns
    • python-patterns (⭐43k) - A collection of design patterns and idioms in Python.
    • python-statemachine (⭐1.3k) - Expressive statecharts and finite state machines with a declarative API, in sync and async codebases.

Projects / Interactive Interpreter

  • notebook (⭐13k) - A web-based notebook environment for interactive computing.
    • awesome-jupyter (⭐4.7k)

Projects / Testing

  • Mock
    • unittest.mock - (Python standard library) A mocking and patching library.
    • responses (⭐4.3k) - A utility library for mocking out the requests Python library.
    • vcrpy (⭐3k) - Record and replay HTTP interactions on your tests.
    • respx (⭐837) - Mock HTTPX with awesome request patterns and response side effects.
    • time-machine (⭐1k) - Travel through time in your tests by mocking the current time at the C level.
  • Object Factories
    • factory-boy (⭐3.8k) - A test fixtures replacement for Python.
    • polyfactory (⭐1.5k) - A mock data generation library based on type hints (continuation of pydantic-factories).

Projects / Debugging Tools

  • Tracing
    • viztracer (⭐7.8k) - A low-overhead tool that traces and visualizes Python code execution.

Projects / Build Tools

  • poethepoet (⭐2.1k) - A task runner that defines tasks in pyproject.toml and works with poetry or uv.

Projects / Job Schedulers

  • Workflow Orchestration
    • dagster (⭐16k) - An orchestration platform for the development, production, and observation of data assets.
    • apache-airflow (⭐47k) - Airflow is a platform to programmatically author, schedule and monitor workflows.
    • prefect (⭐24k) - A modern workflow orchestration framework that makes it easy to build, schedule and monitor robust data pipelines.

Projects / Logging

  • logfire (⭐4.5k) - The observability platform for Python, from the makers of Pydantic.

Projects / Network Virtualization

  • netmiko (⭐4.3k) - Multi-vendor library to simplify CLI connections to network devices.

Projects / CLI Development

  • Terminal Rendering
    • rich (⭐57k) - Python library for rich text and beautiful formatting in the terminal. Also provides a great RichHandler log handler.
    • tqdm (⭐31k) - Fast, extensible progress bar for loops and CLI.
    • colorama (⭐3.8k) - Cross-platform colored terminal text.
    • alive-progress (⭐6.3k) - A new kind of Progress Bar, with real-time throughput, eta and very cool animations.

Projects / GUI Development

  • Desktop
    • PyGObject (⭐159) - Python Bindings for GLib/GObject/GIO/GTK.
    • dearpygui (⭐16k) - A simple GPU-accelerated Python GUI framework.
    • Kivy (⭐19k) - An open-source framework for cross-platform GUI apps on desktop, mobile, and embedded platforms.
    • wxPython (⭐2.6k) - A cross-platform GUI toolkit that wraps the wxWidgets C++ library.
    • toga (⭐5.4k) - A Python native, OS native GUI toolkit.

Projects / Audio & Video Processing

  • Audio
    • soundfile (⭐864) - An audio library for reading and writing sound files, based on libsndfile, CFFI, and NumPy.
    • librosa (⭐8.6k) - Python library for audio and music analysis.
    • pydub (⭐9.8k) - Manipulate audio with a simple and easy high level interface.
  • Video
    • av (⭐3.3k) - Pythonic bindings for FFmpeg's libraries.
    • moviepy (⭐15k) - A module for script-based movie editing with many formats, including animated GIFs.

Projects / Game Development

  • Game Frameworks
    • pyglet (⭐2.2k) - A cross-platform windowing and multimedia library for Python.
    • pygame-ce (⭐1.7k) - An actively developed drop-in replacement with new features and performance improvements (pygame (⭐9k) fork).
    • pygame (⭐9k) - Pygame is a set of Python modules designed for writing games.
    • arcade (⭐2.1k) - An easy-to-use library for creating 2D arcade games.

Projects / Package Repositories

  • pypiserver (⭐2.1k) - A minimal PyPI server for uploading and installing packages with pip.

Projects / Configuration Files

  • hydra-core (⭐11k) - Hydra is a framework for elegantly configuring complex applications.

Projects / Penetration Testing

  • impacket (⭐16k) - A collection of Python classes for working with network protocols, widely used for Windows and Active Directory testing.
  • pwntools (⭐14k) - A CTF framework and exploit development library.

Projects / Web Security

  • nh3 (⭐397) - Python binding to the ammonia HTML sanitizer, a fast replacement for bleach.

Projects / Hardware

  • pyserial (⭐3.6k) - Python serial port access library for Windows, macOS, Linux, and BSD.

entry.title: Awesome Python Updates on Sep 21 - Sep 27, 2026
entry.content:
Projects / AI and Agents

  • Fine-tuning
    • peft (⭐22k) - A library for parameter-efficient fine-tuning of large pretrained models.
    • trl (⭐19k) - A library for post-training transformer language models with SFT, DPO, GRPO, and other trainers.
    • unsloth (⭐77k) - Faster, lower-memory LLM fine-tuning, as a Python library or a desktop app.
    • axolotl (⭐13k) - A framework for fine-tuning and post-training large language models.

Projects / Code Analysis

  • General
    • import-linter (⭐1.2k) - A linter that enforces architectural constraints on imports between Python modules.
    • vulture (⭐4.8k) - A tool for finding and analyzing dead Python code.
    • complexipy (⭐869) - Cognitive complexity analysis for Python code, written in Rust.
    • prospector (⭐2.1k) - A tool to analyze Python code.

entry.title: Awesome Python Updates on Aug 24 - Aug 30, 2026
entry.content:
Projects / Caching

  • hishel (⭐413) - RFC 9111 compliant HTTP caching for clients like httpx and requests and servers like FastAPI, with sync and async support.

Projects / Science

  • Physics and Engineering
    • pint (⭐2.8k) - Operate and manipulate physical quantities with units and dimensional analysis.
    • astropy (⭐5.3k) - A community Python library for Astronomy.
    • obspy (⭐1.3k) - A Python toolbox for seismology.

Projects / Documentation

  • zensical (⭐5.8k) - A modern static site generator for technical documentation.

Projects / Supply Chain Security

  • uv-audit (⭐90k) - (part of uv) uv's dependency vulnerability scanning backed by OSV.

entry.title: Awesome Python Updates on Aug 17 - Aug 23, 2026
entry.content:
Projects / AI and Agents

  • Orchestration
    • langchain (⭐148k) - A framework for building agents and LLM-powered applications.
    • langgraph (⭐43k) - Low-level orchestration framework for building stateful, long-running LLM agents.
    • pydantic-ai (⭐20k) - A Python agent framework for building generative AI applications with structured schemas.
    • crewai (⭐59k) - A framework for orchestrating role-playing autonomous AI agents for collaborative task solving.
  • Prompt Optimization
    • dspy (⭐39k) - A framework for programming, not prompting, language models.
  • Data Layer
    • instructor (⭐14k) - A library for extracting structured data from LLMs, powered by Pydantic.
    • llama-index (⭐52k) - A toolkit for building RAG pipelines and agents over your data.
    • mem0 (⭐66k) - An intelligent memory layer for AI agents enabling personalized interactions.
    • openviking (⭐39k) - A context database for AI agents that unifies memory, resources, and skills.
    • semantica (⭐14k) - A graph-native context and knowledge layer for AI agents with reasoning, provenance, and governance.
  • Pre-trained Models
    • transformers (⭐167k) - The model-definition framework for pretrained models in text, computer vision, audio, video, and multimodal tasks, for inference and training.
  • LLM Inference and Serving
    • sglang (⭐37k) - A high-performance serving framework for large language models and multimodal models.
    • vllm (⭐93k) - A high-throughput and memory-efficient inference and serving engine for LLMs.
    • mlx-lm (⭐7.2k) - Run and fine-tune large language models on Apple Silicon with MLX.

Projects / Deep Learning

  • Reinforcement Learning
    • gymnasium (⭐13k) - A standard API for reinforcement learning environments with popular reference environments (gym (⭐37k) successor).
    • stable-baselines3 (⭐14k) - PyTorch implementations of Stable Baselines (deep) reinforcement learning algorithms.

Projects / Natural Language Processing

  • General
    • nltk (⭐15k) - A leading platform for building Python programs to work with human language data.
    • spacy (⭐34k) - A library for industrial-strength natural language processing in Python and Cython.
    • gensim (⭐16k) - Topic Modeling for Humans.
    • stanza (⭐7.9k) - The Stanford NLP Group's official Python library, supporting 60+ languages.
  • Chinese
    • jieba (⭐35k) - The most popular Chinese text segmentation library.
    • pypinyin (⭐5.4k) - Convert Chinese hanzi (漢字) to pinyin (拼音).
    • pangu.py (⭐280) - Paranoid text spacing.

Projects / Computer Vision

  • General
    • opencv-python (⭐5.4k) - Open Source Computer Vision Library.
    • ultralytics (⭐62k) - Ultralytics YOLO for object detection, segmentation, pose estimation, classification, and tracking.
    • kornia (⭐11k) - Open Source Differentiable Computer Vision Library for PyTorch.
    • fiftyone (⭐11k) - The open-source tool for building high-quality datasets and computer vision models.

Projects / Web Frameworks

  • Synchronous
    • flask (⭐75k) - A microframework for Python.
      • awesome-flask (⭐13k)
    • django (⭐91k) - A high-level web framework that encourages rapid development and clean, pragmatic design.
      • awesome-django (⭐11k)
    • bottle (⭐8.8k) - A fast and simple micro-framework distributed as a single file with no dependencies.
    • pyramid (⭐4.1k) - A small, fast, down-to-earth, open source Python web framework.
    • fasthtml (⭐7k) - The fastest way to create an HTML app.
  • Asynchronous
    • starlette (⭐13k) - A lightweight ASGI framework and toolkit for building high-performance async services.
    • tornado (⭐22k) - A web framework and asynchronous networking library.
    • litestar (⭐8.5k) - Production-ready, capable and extensible ASGI Web framework.
    • reflex (⭐29k) - A framework for building reactive, full-stack web applications entirely with Python.

Projects / Web APIs

  • Django
    • django-rest-framework (⭐30k) - A powerful and flexible toolkit to build web APIs.
    • django-ninja (⭐9.2k) - Fast, Django REST framework based on type hints and Pydantic.
    • strawberry-django (⭐504) - Strawberry GraphQL integration with Django.
    • django-modern-rest (⭐1.5k) - Modern REST with speed, types, async, msgspec, pydantic and other goodies!
  • Framework Agnostic
    • fastapi (⭐103k) - A modern, fast, web framework for building APIs with standard Python type hints.
    • strawberry (⭐4.7k) - A GraphQL library that leverages Python type annotations for schema definition.
    • connexion (⭐4.6k) - A spec-first framework that automatically handles requests based on your OpenAPI specification.

Projects / Web Servers

  • ASGI
    • uvicorn (⭐11k) - A lightning-fast ASGI server implementation.
    • granian (⭐5.7k) - A Rust HTTP server for Python applications built on top of Hyper and Tokio, supporting WSGI/ASGI/RSGI.
    • hypercorn (⭐1.6k) - An ASGI and WSGI Server based on Hyper libraries and inspired by Gunicorn.

Projects / Authentication

  • OAuth
    • oauthlib (⭐3k) - A generic and thorough implementation of the OAuth request-signing logic.
    • authlib (⭐5.4k) - A comprehensive library for building OAuth, OpenID Connect, and JWT/JWS/JWE/JWK/JWA.
    • django-allauth (⭐10k) - Authentication app for Django that "just works."
    • django-oauth-toolkit (⭐3.3k) - An OAuth 2.0 authorization server for Django.

Projects / ERP

  • odoo (⭐55k) - A suite of open source business apps: CRM, e-commerce, accounting, inventory, and thousands of community modules.

Projects / HTTP Clients

  • URL Manipulation
    • yarl (⭐1.5k) - Yet another URL library.

Projects / ORM

  • Relational Databases
    • sqlalchemy (⭐12k) - The Python SQL Toolkit and Object Relational Mapper.
      • awesome-sqlalchemy (⭐3.1k)
    • django.db.models (⭐91k) - (part of Django) The Django ORM.
    • peewee (⭐12k) - A small, expressive ORM.
    • sqlmodel (⭐18k) - SQLModel is based on Python type annotations, and powered by Pydantic and SQLAlchemy.
  • NoSQL Databases
    • pynamodb (⭐2.6k) - A Pythonic interface for Amazon DynamoDB.
    • mongoengine (⭐4.3k) - A Python Object-Document-Mapper for working with MongoDB.
    • beanie (⭐2.7k) - An asynchronous Python object-document mapper (ODM) for MongoDB.
    • django-mongodb-backend (⭐228) - Official MongoDB database backend for Django.

Projects / Database Drivers

  • ClickHouse
    • clickhouse-connect (⭐524) - The official ClickHouse client, with SQLAlchemy and Superset connectors.
    • clickhouse-driver (⭐1.3k) - Python driver with native interface for ClickHouse.
  • Other Relational Databases
    • pyodbc (⭐3.1k) - An ODBC bridge for connecting to SQL Server and any other ODBC-accessible database.
    • oracledb (⭐454) - The official Python driver for Oracle Database, successor to cx_Oracle.
    • mssql-python (⭐476) - Official Microsoft driver for SQL Server and Azure SQL, built on ODBC for high performance.
  • NoSQL Databases
    • redis (⭐14k) - The Python client for Redis.
    • pymongo (⭐4.4k) - The official Python client for MongoDB.
    • cassandra-driver (⭐1.4k) - The Python Driver for Apache Cassandra.

Projects / Caching

  • diskcache (⭐2.9k) - SQLite and file backed cache backend, compatible with Django.

Projects / Search

  • opensearch-py (⭐471) - The official low-level Python client for OpenSearch.
  • elasticsearch (⭐4.4k) - The official low-level Python client for Elasticsearch.
  • meilisearch (⭐605) - The official Python client for the Meilisearch search engine.

Projects / Data Analysis

  • ibis-framework (⭐6.7k) - A portable Python dataframe library with a single API for 20+ backends.

Projects / Data Ingestion / ETL

  • General
    • awswrangler (⭐4.1k) - Pandas integration with AWS services like Athena, Glue, Redshift, S3, and DynamoDB.
    • dlt (⭐5.9k) - A Python library for building data pipelines with automatic schema inference, incremental loading, and support for multiple sources and destinations.
  • Financial Data
    • yfinance (⭐25k) - Easy Pythonic way to download market and financial data from Yahoo Finance.
    • akshare (⭐23k) - A financial data interface library, with data provided for academic research only.
    • edgartools (⭐2.8k) - Library for downloading structured data from SEC EDGAR filings and XBRL financial statements.
    • openbb (⭐74k) - A financial data platform for analysts, quants and AI agents.

Projects / Data Visualization

  • Plotting
    • matplotlib (⭐23k) - A comprehensive library for creating static, animated, and interactive visualizations.
    • plotly (⭐19k) - Interactive graphing library for Python.
    • seaborn (⭐14k) - Statistical data visualization using Matplotlib.
    • altair (⭐10k) - Declarative statistical visualization library for Python.
    • bokeh (⭐20k) - Interactive Web Plotting for Python.
  • Dashboards and Apps
    • streamlit (⭐46k) - A framework which lets you build dashboards, generate reports, or create chat apps in minutes.
    • dash (⭐24k) - A framework for building data apps and dashboards in pure Python, built on Plotly.
    • gradio (⭐44k) - Build and share machine learning apps, all in Python.

Projects / Science

  • Core
    • numpy (⭐33k) - A fundamental package for scientific computing with Python.
    • scipy (⭐15k) - Fundamental algorithms for scientific computing in Python.
    • numba (⭐11k) - A NumPy-aware JIT compiler for Python, using LLVM.
  • Symbolic Mathematics
    • sympy (⭐15k) - A Python library for symbolic mathematics.
  • Statistics
    • statsmodels (⭐12k) - Statistical modeling and econometrics in Python.
  • Simulation and Modeling
    • pymc (⭐9.8k) - Probabilistic programming and Bayesian modeling in Python.
    • simpy - A process-based discrete-event simulation framework.
    • mesa (⭐3.9k) - An agent-based modeling framework for building, analyzing, and visualizing complex system simulations.
  • Graphs and Networks
    • networkx (⭐17k) - A high-productivity software for complex networks.
  • Computational Geometry
    • shapely (⭐4.5k) - Manipulation and analysis of geometric objects in the Cartesian plane.
  • Other
    • colour-science (⭐2.7k) - Implementing a comprehensive number of colour theory transformations and algorithms.
    • manim (⭐41k) - An animation engine for explanatory math videos.

Projects / Quantum Computing

  • cirq (⭐5.1k) - A Google-developed framework focused on hardware-aware quantum circuit design for NISQ devices.

Projects / Algorithms and Design Patterns

  • Algorithms
    • sortedcontainers (⭐4k) - Fast and pure-Python implementation of sorted collections.
    • algorithms (⭐26k) - Minimal examples of data structures and algorithms.
    • thealgorithms (⭐225k) - All Algorithms implemented in Python.

Projects / Interactive Interpreter

  • ipython (⭐17k) - A powerful interactive Python shell, and the kernel behind Jupyter notebooks.

Projects / Code Analysis

  • Git Hooks
    • pre-commit (⭐16k) - A framework for managing and maintaining multi-language pre-commit hooks.
  • Linters and Formatters
    • ruff (⭐50k) - An extremely fast Python linter and code formatter.
    • black (⭐42k) - The uncompromising Python code formatter.
    • isort (⭐7k) - A Python utility / library to sort imports.
    • pylint (⭐5.7k) - A fully customizable source code analyzer.
    • flake8 (⭐3.8k) - A wrapper around pycodestyle, pyflakes and McCabe.
      • awesome-flake8-extensions (⭐1.3k)
    • bandit (⭐8.3k) - A tool designed to find common security issues in Python code.

Projects / Testing

  • Frameworks
    • pytest (⭐15k) - A mature full-featured Python testing tool.
      • awesome-pytest (⭐575)
    • hypothesis (⭐9k) - Hypothesis is an advanced Quickcheck style property based testing library.
    • robotframework (⭐12k) - A generic test automation framework.
  • Test Runners
    • tox (⭐3.9k) - Auto builds and tests distributions in multiple Python versions.
    • nox (⭐1.6k) - Flexible test automation for Python.
  • Browser Automation
    • playwright-python (⭐15k) - Python version of the Playwright testing and automation library.
    • selenium (⭐35k) - Python bindings for Selenium WebDriver.
    • seleniumbase (⭐13k) - Python framework for web automation & testing, with stealth options.
  • API Testing
    • schemathesis (⭐3.6k) - A tool for automatic property-based testing of web APIs from OpenAPI or GraphQL schemas.

Projects / Documentation

  • mkdocs-material (⭐28k) - A documentation framework and Material Design theme built on MkDocs.

Projects / DevOps Tools

  • Cloud Providers
    • boto3 (⭐9.9k) - Python interface to Amazon Web Services.
    • awscli (⭐17k) - Universal Command Line Interface for Amazon Web Services; the PyPI package is v1, in maintenance mode, while v2 ships as AWS's bundled installer.
    • azure-sdk-for-python (⭐5.6k) - Microsoft Azure SDK for Python, published as per-service packages.
    • google-cloud-python (⭐5.4k) - Google Cloud client libraries for Python, published as per-service packages.
  • Deployment
    • fabric (⭐16k) - A simple, Pythonic tool for remote execution and deployment.
    • chalice (⭐11k) - A Python serverless microframework for AWS.
  • Other
    • borgbackup (⭐14k) - A deduplicating archiver with compression and encryption.

Projects / Distributed Computing

  • pyspark (⭐44k) - Apache Spark Python API.
  • ray (⭐44k) - A unified framework for scaling AI and Python applications.
  • joblib (⭐4.4k) - Parallel computing and disk-based caching for Python functions.
  • mpi4py (⭐926) - Python bindings for MPI.

Projects / Messaging

  • confluent-kafka (⭐516) - Confluent's Python client for Apache Kafka, built on librdkafka.
  • pika (⭐3.9k) - Pure-Python RabbitMQ/AMQP 0-9-1 client library.
  • paho-mqtt (⭐2.4k) - The Eclipse Paho MQTT client for Python.

Projects / CLI Development

  • TUI Frameworks
    • textual (⭐37k) - A framework for building interactive user interfaces that run in the terminal and the browser.
    • urwid (⭐3k) - A library for creating terminal GUI applications with strong support for widgets, events, rich colors, etc.
    • asciimatics (⭐4.3k) - A package to create full-screen text UIs (from interactive forms to ASCII animations).

Projects / CLI Tools

  • Database CLIs
    • pgcli (⭐13k) - PostgreSQL CLI with autocompletion and syntax highlighting.
    • mycli (⭐12k) - MySQL CLI with autocompletion and syntax highlighting.
    • litecli (⭐3.3k) - SQLite CLI with autocompletion and syntax highlighting.
    • iredis (⭐2.8k) - Redis CLI with autocompletion and syntax highlighting.
  • Downloaders
    • yt-dlp (⭐193k) - A command-line program to download videos from YouTube and other video sites, a fork of youtube-dl.
  • Shells
